sections.title: Songs
sections.note: The ten songs on the Quest Status screen, in story order. Songs stay through the Song of Time.

items.name: Song of Time
items.howTo: In the first cycle, take the Ocarina back from the Skull Kid at midnight on the Final Day; Zelda's memory teaches you the song.
items.reward: Back to the Dawn of the First Day, saving your progress

items.name: Song of Healing
items.howTo: Back on the Dawn of the First Day after the first cycle, the Happy Mask Salesman teaches it to you.
items.reward: Heals troubled souls into masks; the first lifts your Deku curse

items.name: Sonata of Awakening
items.howTo: As a Deku, reach the caged Monkey from the Inner Palace Garden side (via the Magic Bean grotto and the Deku flowers) and listen to his song.

items.name: Song of Soaring
items.howTo: Read the stone monument at the end of the Woodfall Temple Pathway, next to the way into Woodfall, as a Deku.
items.reward: Warps to any Owl Statue you've struck, or to a temple's entrance
items.notes: In Majora's Mask 3D the monument is at the entrance to the Southern Swamp.

items.name: Oath to Order
items.howTo: After beating Odolwa, the freed Swamp Giant teaches it to you.
items.reward: Calls the Four Giants from the Clock Tower

items.name: Epona's Song
items.howTo: On Day 1 (6 a.m.–6 p.m.), beat Romani's balloon game with the Hero's Bow. Get into the ranch by blowing up the boulder on Milk Road with a Powder Keg.

items.name: Goron Lullaby
items.howTo: As a Goron, find the Goron Elder frozen on the way up to Snowhead, thaw him with Hot Spring Water and play the drums for him: he teaches the Lullaby Intro. Play the intro for his crying son in the Goron Shrine and he sings the rest.
items.reward: Puts the giant Goron blocking Snowhead to sleep

items.name: New Wave Bossa Nova
items.area: Marine Research Lab, Great Bay Coast
items.howTo: Bring all seven Zora Eggs (four from the Pirates' Fortress, three from Pinnacle Rock) to the Marine Research Lab's tank in one cycle, then play your guitar as a Zora.
items.reward: Wakes the giant turtle to Great Bay Temple

items.name: Song of Storms
items.howTo: On Night 1, use the Captain's Hat to have the Stalchildren open their grave. Find your way past the Iron Knuckle to Flat's tomb; the composer's ghost teaches you the song.
items.reward: Rain: Magic Bean water, and it cleanses Sharp's curse in the Spring Water Cave

items.name: Elegy of Emptiness
items.howTo: Beat Igos du Ikana and his lackeys in the castle's throne room; the king teaches it to you.
items.after: Mirror Shield, Hero's Bow and Powder Keg or Fire Arrows
items.reward: Leaves a statue of your form behind; needed to climb Stone Tower

sections.title: Other songs
sections.note: Variations on the Song of Time. They work as soon as you know them but are never listed on the Quest Status screen.

items.name: Inverted Song of Time
items.howTo: Pierre the Scarecrow hints at it: play the Song of Time backwards.
items.reward: Slows time to a third of its speed until you play it again
items.notes: In Majora's Mask 3D it slows time to half speed.

items.name: Song of Double Time
items.howTo: Pierre the Scarecrow hints at it: play each of the Song of Time's notes twice.
items.reward: Skips ahead to the next dawn or nightfall
items.notes: In Majora's Mask 3D you choose the hour to skip to.
